Text: On Windows 10/11 with clipboard history on: copy a fictional password via secure_clipboard.copy(secret=True) and confirm it does not appear in Win+V.
SMTI OS card on TRACES and on a normal portal: look matches the in-page card (buttons, step cards, timer), Username/Password fill, copy fallback pastes, ✎ opens SCK for that client
MECP OS card next to the extension's in-page MECP card (plain and SCC mode): same look, copies paste correctly, combo copies show in the SCC ledger, This one worked / None / x reach the desktop
Look at the OS SCA card and fill chip next to the extension's in-page ones (colours, amber needs_confirm border, spacing, fade) in a real browser; chip must not steal focus.
Compare docs/os_assist/shots/*.png with the extension cards on a real page

OS engine: Client Detail SMTI and MECP buttons open a new portal tab and the card docks over that browser within a few seconds; a second press replaces the card; with no browser window found in 20 s an error dialog names the portal

OS mode SCA: copy a PAN in Excel, type it on GST and on Income Tax (PAN page, Continue, password page): password filled + chip; unverified IT client: amber card, Inject fills; with an SMTI card open on the window SCA stays quiet; extension draws no SCA card in OS mode and works again after switching back to Extension.

Real browser: with assist_engine=os, trigger an SCC attempt (SGT sees an Income Tax password page) and from Client Detail MECP on an unverified PAN; confirm the SCC card docks to that browser window, Copy / This one worked / None / x work, marks update, and the card closes on save.

Engine OS with the extension connected: copy a PAN, type it on GST - exactly one fill (Sera's chip), no extension SCA card or chip; then switch to Extension in Settings without a restart and repeat - the extension fills as before.
